$comment: The source of sf-chart-metric (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 in the 1.4 form, vocabulary 1.1.5). The catalogue's KPI and Larena's metric tile in one component (docs/research/parameters.md §15 of ui-chart; dispatcher bus msg-d0bbcfb263ca49d2ba05).

label.summary: What the number is, in a few words: the tile's accessible name. Required in practice: without it the tile is named «Показатель».

value.summary: The number. Unset, the tile says «—» (data-state auto is then empty).

format.summary: number, integer, decimal-<n>, percent (a share 0..1), compact, currency-<CODE> or unit-<Intl unit> (unit-gigabyte, unit-megabit-per-second), in the page's language. The change and the limit are said the same way.

previous.summary: The value of the previous period; the change is worked out from it when delta is not given.

delta.summary: The change itself, when the page has it; it wins over previous.

delta-format.summary: How the change is written: its share of the previous value, the difference in the value's format, or both. Without a previous value it is the difference.

period-text.summary: What the change is against, after it: «к прошлой неделе».

better.summary: Whether a rise is good: up for sales, down for server load or errors, none when neither. The change's tone follows its meaning, not its sign.

max.summary: A limit: the tile shows «value of max» with a meter (storage, a licence, a quota).

limit-text.summary: The words under the meter instead of «45 ГБ из 100 ГБ».

status.summary: The page's statement about the number, in the shared status vocabulary: a dot of that tone and the hint. Thresholds are the page's; the tile never infers a status from the value.

hint.summary: A short line beside the status: «Свободно меньше 10 %».

href.summary: Makes the whole tile one link to this address.

openable.summary: Without href: makes the whole tile one button that sends open.

size.summary: The rung of the size ladder: the value's text, the gaps. 1/2 for a dense row, 2 for a page's headline figure.

data-state.summary: auto: ready with a value, empty without («—»). loading holds the tile's size with a skeleton of the value; the error of a load is the status and the hint.

open.summary: The person pressed an openable tile (Enter, Space or a click); the host opens the details.

chart.$comment: A chart under the number, as a rule an sf-chart-sparkline of the same series; plain content placed as it is (standard §4.5). It fills the tile's width.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

skeleton.$comment: The value arrives after the first paint when the host loads it: data-state loading holds the tile's size with a skeleton of the value line (standard 1.3.8 §5.4).

accessibility.x-keys: A plain tile is a group named by its label and takes no focus. With href it is one link, with openable one button: a single Tab stop, Enter (and Space for the button) opens. The change is said with its direction in words («рост», «снижение»), the limit is a meter with its value text, the status is said in words before the hint.

x-summary: A metric tile: one number with its label, the change against a previous period said in words and by an arrow, a limit as a meter, the page's status with a hint, an optional sparkline, and the whole tile as one link or button.
x-decisions: name: sf-chart-metric, the Framework's naming rule sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>], block chart (the owner's decision of 2026-11-02, ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-02-smart-component-naming.md; docs/DECISIONS.md D2), family chart; it serves the catalogue's KPI and Larena's metric tile as one component (D1, the dispatcher's request).
the meaning of a change is the page's: better says whether a rise is good, and the tone follows it, never the sign alone; the direction is also an arrow and a word.
status is the shared status vocabulary (neutral, success, warning, error, info) and the page's statement: thresholds are never inferred from the value.

the limit is a meter (role meter with its value text); the bar inside is sf-progress-bar through its public surface, hidden from the accessibility tree, so the tile is not announced as a progress bar.
one target: href makes the tile a link, openable a button; nothing interactive goes inside, so the chart slot takes a non-interactive chart (sf-chart-sparkline).
the chart slot is plain content (§4.5) for now: a slot that accepts only charts needs a chart@1 interface (§4.5.1, §20), which the package adds when a second consumer needs it.
no error state: a failed load is the status (error) with a hint; data-state stops at empty.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chart-metric for one number that matters with its change, its limit or its status: a dashboard's row of figures, a server's load, storage, a quota.
do_not: Do not infer a status from the value; the page states it
Do not put buttons or links inside the tile; give it href or openable
Do not colour a change without better; a rise is not always good
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-chart-metric label="Выручка за неделю" value="1250000" previous="1100000" format="currency-RUB"></sf-chart-metric>

accessibility.focus: None for a plain tile; one Tab stop for a link or a button tile.

$comment: The limit's meter draws sf-progress-bar; a tag it renders is a tag it fetches.
